what: Every route tried, 2026-09-15, to install a control surface on a ko-KR Logic 12.3 (6674) without a human using the GUI

preference_file.format: not a plist — the first four bytes are 4d 52 4f 46, i.e. the IFF 'FORM' chunk magic written back to front. Logic writes `gnoS` for 'Song' in ProjectData the same way, so this is its legacy IFF-style chunk container, not a private format with no lineage.
preference_file.note_after_install: Installing the device rewrote the file: 27505 -> 264770 bytes (9.6x) and `Control Surface: Mackie Control` / `Loud Technologies / Mackie` now sit in it as plain text. This is the difference `Rebuild Defaults` did NOT make — that only added the port names and left the window reading `기기 없음`.

coremidi.note: the virtual ports exist only while a server process is alive; with none running there is nothing for Logic to bind to

routes_tried.route: 컨트롤 서피스 설정 window, its only unnamed AXButton
컨트롤 서피스 submenu, all 8 items enumerated

routes_tried.opened: AXDialog titled 설정, 37 controls — global control-surface preferences (픽업 모드, 페이더를 터치하여 트랙 선택, …)

routes_tried.route: 컨트롤 서피스 > 기본값 재형성, WITH the MCU ports up
routes_tried.effect: the ports were LEARNED into the preference file; no device was installed

routes_tried.route: the application menu bar while the Setup window is key
routes_tried.effect: unchanged — the window contributes no menu of its own to AX

product_after_all_of_it.hint: MCU feedback not detected: no feedback has been received on 'LogicProMCP-MCU-Internal' (2 endpoint(s) visible, all owned by this server).

incidents: Pressing `button 1` of the Setup window to close it OPENED 컨트롤러 할당 instead — an unnamed button addressed by index, which is the positional targeting this repository refuses everywhere else.
컨트롤러 할당 and 설정 then refused Cmd+W and had to be dismissed with Escape (key code 53), the documented open-window wedge.

A held server process kept the MCU endpoints alive after its call finished, and the product then refused with a DIFFERENT message — 'include one this server did not create' — so a stale endpoint is distinguishable from an absent device, which is worth knowing.
